abstract: RepeatViewer is a graphical user interface application designed for repetitive sequence inspection and curation, especially focusing on, but not limited to, transposable elements (TEs). It automatically identifies structural features of TEs, including long terminal repeats (LTRs), terminal inverted repeats (TIRs), and target side duplications (TSDs). All detected and user-defined annotations can be interactively inspected, edited, and exported. RepeatViewer also integrates a TE curation workflow intended to facilitate their manual refinement. In addition, it provides interactive visualization of TE sequences and genome-wide TE annotations, such as dot plots as well as TE distribution and divergence analyses. RepeatViewer is modularly built and can be easily customized by the user.
